stages.text: The crew sealed the section, but the hull is damaged.
A circuit is drawing uneven power.
The surge is pulling power out of the reserve.
The circuit trips and drains the reserve.
Two hands are arguing over shifts.
The disagreement is affecting the whole crew.
The argument subsides, leaving tempers frayed.
A radiation front is approaching the ship.
The front is stressing the shields.
The front has passed, leaving the hull scorched.
An unknown signal is interrupting routine traffic.
The interference is wearing on the crew.
The signal fades back into the static.

gal-core: The Compact joined crowded worlds into a common market.
The archives remember agreements the markets outgrew.
gal-halo: Ice haulers carried the first lamps into the cold.
Isolation makes water, shelter and a working beacon precious.
gal-inner: The first lanes were chartered by independent haulers.
Old salvage rights still divide the ports.
gal-outer: Convoys built their own stations beyond the assembly's reach.
Long supply lines remain their common obligation.
gal-rift: Broken lanes forced scattered havens to negotiate passage.
Every crossing still relies on a promise between pilots.
gal-shoal: Wrecks and listening posts mark an older migration.
The names of many vessels were lost before their signals.
gal-verge: Small harbours grew around ships that could go no farther.
Weather and empty fuel tanks erase routes every year.
